evidence: Nep. Att. 21: cibum with sūmere (Lewis & Short s.v. sūmō)
Traupman 38: to eat breakfast, jentāculum sūmere
terms.comment: Sūmere, to take, is the verb for any meal: prandium, cēnam sūmere.

short-e.against: Bennett’s hidden long ē, printed in an earlier version of this entry
short-e.html: Lewis & Short leaves the e unmarked, as in jentāculum (jentaculum, jento). The reading after Bennett was withdrawn on review.

sources: Lewis & Short: jento · Bennett: hidden quantities, with later corrections
